events.name: Bash
events.head: Check existing T-255 commit, repo state and audit entries
events.input: $ git show --stat 9b85895 | head -30; git status --short | head -30; git log --oneline origin/main -1 2>/dev/null; git remote -v; grep -n "G013\|G124" [redacted].md | head; grep -rn "flowByMechanism" app/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare local main with origin and locate the guide checks
events.input: $ git fetch origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main; git log --oneline origin/main -5; git show --stat --format=%H%n%s 82b9205 | head -15; git log --oneline -8 -- [redacted].ts app/src/lib/guides/schema.ts app/src/components/guides/guide-view.tsx; cd [redacted] && git status --short 2>&1 | head -5; git log --oneline -3 2>&1; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/scripts | grep -i "guide\|flow"; grep -n "check-guides\|probe-guides\|probe-flows" app/package.json

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run check-guides and inspect probe setup
events.input: $ cd [redacted] && git diff --stat 9b85895 HEAD -- src/lib/guides src/components/guides src/content/guides/s2-landing scripts/probe-guides.mjs scripts/probe-flows.mjs | tail -3; grep -n "flowByMechanism" -r src | head -20; head -40 scripts/probe-guides.mjs; grep -n "MECH\|BASE\|PORT" scripts/probe-flows.mjs | head -20; node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -i node | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find why s5-pipeline fails the node limit
events.input: $ git log --oneline -4 -- src/content/guides | cat; f=$(grep -rl '"s5-pipeline"\|id: "s5-pipeline"' src/content/guides | head -1); echo $f; git log --oneline -4 -- $f | cat; grep -n "14" src/lib/guides/validate.ts scripts/check-guides.mjs | head; git log --oneline -3 -- src/lib/guides/validate.ts | cat; awk '/flow: \{/,/edges:/' $f | grep -c "id:"; awk '/flow: \{/,/edges:/' $f

events.name: Bash
events.head: See when the 14-node failure was introduced
events.input: $ git show 9b85895 -- src/lib/guides/validate.ts | cat; git show 36d9956 --stat --format='%h %ad %s' | head; git show 36d9956 -- [redacted].ts | grep '^[+-]' | cut -c1-110 | head -20; grep -rn "14 nodes\|> 14\|14 node" src scripts ../workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-220 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: List listening ports and read the flow probe
events.input: $ lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}' | sort -u | head -30; sed -n 1,60p scripts/probe-flows.mjs; sed -n 1,25p src/lib/guides/layout.ts

events.input: $ grep -n '"dev"\|"build"\|"start"' package.json; grep -n "4322" -r ../.claude/launch.json | head -5; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -m 5 http://localhost:4322/debug/guides; node scripts/probe-flows.mjs 2>&1 | tail -5

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ set -e; W=$(mktemp -d)/t255; git worktree add -q --detach "$W" origin/main; cd "$W"; git cherry-pick 12a5306 >/dev/null; git log --oneline -2 | cat; git diff --stat HEAD~1 | cat; git push origin HEAD:main 2>&1 | tail -2; H=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD); cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git worktree remove "$W"; git fetch -q origin; git log --oneline origin/main -1 | cat; echo PUSHED=$H

events.text: T-255 is in review: the S2 landing guide draws its own webinar, RSP and challenge charts, `check-guides` and both probes pass for all three mechanisms (after I raised the chart node cap from 14 to 18 for T-254's 17-node pipeline chart), it is pushed to main (82b9205, 52c226c), and G013 and G124 are marked fixed in AUDIT.md.
